name: Bot Foundry
author: axel8721

sections.description:
Bot Foundry is a powerful, yet easy-to-use WordPress plugin that brings a smart AI chatbot to your website. With a simple setup process, you only need to scan your site to create an interactive map of your pages, enabling the chatbot to guide visitors effectively. The scanning feature not only helps users navigate your site with ease but also ensures that the chatbot is well-informed about your content, making every interaction more relevant and helpful.

All data collected during the scan can be removed at any time, making the plugin fully GDPR compliant. This ensures that your visitors’ privacy is respected while still providing them with a seamless support experience.

Key Features:

  • Easy Setup: Simply scan your site to build a comprehensive content map, then enable the chatbot with a single click.
  • Enhanced Navigation: The chatbot helps users quickly find the information they need, improving user experience and reducing bounce rates.
  • GDPR Compliant: Full control over your site’s data—delete the scanned data anytime to comply with GDPR regulations.
  • Real-Time Support: Offers instant, personalized responses to customer inquiries, driving higher engagement and satisfaction.
  • Premium Customization: Upgrade to the premium version for advanced options:
    • Goal Customization: Define the purpose and behavior of your chatbot to better align with your business objectives.
    • Page-Specific Settings: Choose which pages the chatbot appears on, ensuring optimal support where your users need it most.

Quick and easy setup to get started

Get started in minutes with a streamlined installation process. Simply scan your website, enable the chatbot, and watch as botfoundry transforms your site’s user interaction—offering immediate assistance and personalized guidance.

Other information

Frontend source files are located in the src folder

External Services

Our plugin leverages an external API to store the HTML content of published pages that are publicly accessible on our website. This data is automatically deleted if it remains unused for three months.
Users can also manually remove page data by selecting the “Remove Page Data” option on the setup page. This ensures our AI always has timely access to the necessary information for optimal performance.
For frontend users, session data is maintained until the chat window is closed. Additionally, all other information—such as AI instructions for premium users—is stored locally on the website and included in each session.

The current domain and endpoint for the external api is https://www.bot-foundry.com/api
in addition to that https://js.stripe.com and https://www.bot-foundry.com/static/stripe/client.js is used to provide the ability to subscribe to the plugin and is provided by stripe.
